prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted 2D gothic fantasy action platformer.
Create a NEW tall sprite sheet, width:height EXACTLY 3:5, six equal columns and ten equal rows (60 complete character poses). True transparent alpha background. No text, no grid lines, no environment, no particles, no glow splashes, no detached projectiles. Each cell has at least15percent empty transparent gutter on ALL sides. Full creature never touches a cell boundary. All face RIGHT. Crisp dark ink contours, painted amber, ochre, bone ivory and charcoal. Expressive clear silhouettes. This is not a repetition of the old sheet's frame arrangement: every creature's first SIX poses must be a genuine locomotion cycle, NEVER three move followed by three anticipation.
Five creatures each occupy TWO consecutive rows; body design, body proportions and scale must remain invariant across both rows.
Rows1and2 low charcoal cave crab with amber crystal pincer, matching the reference cave crab. Row1 has six leg-alternating walking cycle poses, pincer neutral in all six. Row2: columns1and2 pincer drawn way back in tense anticipation, columns3and4 pincer snaps forward horizontally, columns5and6 recoils then returns neutral.
Rows3and4 squat cave toad with amber resin cheeks and acorn throat sac. Row3 six locomotion poses: crouch, push off, airborne rising, apex tuck, extend feet, land. Throat remains SMALL in every locomotion frame. Row4 columns1and2 throat inflates in anticipation;3and4 body leans forward with mouth open spitting (NO visible projectile);5and6 throat deflates and body relaxes.
Rows5and6 cave moth with lantern amber abdomen and mineral wings. Row5 six distinct smooth wingbeat stages upstroke, spread, downstroke, foldedlow, recoveryspread, upstroke; abdomen neutral allsix. Row6 columns1and2 abdomen draws back with tucked tense wings;3and4 abdomen snaps forward firing (NO projectile);5and6 relaxes.
Rows7and8 floating mushroom jellyfish with amber bell cap and root tendrils. Row7 six pulsing drifting cycle poses with alternation in cap compression and tendril wave. Row8 columns1and2 cap draws inward tense;3and4 bell underside opens down to drop a pod (NO pod shown);5and6 closes and relaxes.
Rows9and10 blind root-armored beetle with broad amber ram horn and heavy forelegs. Row9 six alternating walking stages, horn neutral; Row10 columns1and2 plants forefeet and lowers horn,3and4 powerful bodily forward lunge,5and6 brakes then returnsneutral.
Important all creatures remain fully contained and centered in their own cell, feet consistent on common baseline for each row. All six locomotion poses are anatomically coherent and cyclic, not six copies. Clean source image suitable for cropping individual cells. Reference gives visual identities only, do NOT copy its old timing arrangement.
